title: Guided Dual Antiplatelet Therapy After Coronary Artery Bypass Graft - Does it improve patient safety?

interventions.name: The following study does not classify as an intervention study. After coronary artery bypass graft surgery, patients are treated with either aspirin alone or aspirin and clopidogrel. This study shall investigate, whether an individualized approach with dose reduction of clopiogrel leads to less seve

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Written consent, minimum age of 18 years, medication with at least one antiplatelet agent
Exclusion criteria:
Impairment of verbal communication/ language, no written consent, other indication for anticoagulant or antiplatelet agent, hereditary or acquired bleeding disorder, allergy to aspirin or clopidogrel, women of child-bearing age, history of bleeding
